Talent0_2Ability.name: Field Doctor
Talent0_2Ability.SpecificEffects: When performing active repairs, Repair AMT <color=#F74848>+8%</color>.

Talent3_5Ability.name: Field Doctor
Talent3_5Ability.SpecificEffects: When performing active repairs, Repair AMT <color=#F74848>+10%</color>.

500001.name: CEC 1
500001.SpecificEffects: In cooperation with allies, launch a <buf ID=900002>[Link Attack]</buf> against the target, dealing <color=#F74848>0.2x</color> DMG, effective up to <color=#F74848>1</color> time per turn.

500102.name: Armor Tending
500102.SpecificEffects: After performing active repairs, grant <buf ID=7101601>[Armor Down Immunity]</buf> and <buf ID=7101604>[DMG Taken Immunity]</buf> to the target, lasting for <color=#F74848>2</color> turns.

700019.name: Cross Repair
700019.describe: Restore the HP of all allies within a <range type=1>Cross (1 tile)</range> area, with the repair amount being <color=#F74848>1x</color> the Manipulator's Repair AMT. This can repair <color=#F74848>1</color> damaged part.

500104.name: Firearm Tending
500104.SpecificEffects: After performing active repairs, grant <buf ID=7101606>[DMG Down Immunity]</buf> and <buf ID=7101603>[Hit Down Immunity]</buf> to the target, lasting for <color=#F74848>2</color> turns.

500105.name: First Aid
500105.SpecificEffects: When performing active repairs, if the target's HP is below <color=#F74848>30%</color>, Repair AMT <color=#F74848>+15%</color>.

500106.name: Intensive Repair
500106.describe: Restore HP of all parts of an ST. The repair amount is <color=#F74848>2.3x</color> the Manipulator's Repair AMT. This skill can repair <color=#F74848>2</color> damaged parts.

500107.name: Regulated Repair
500107.describe: Restores HP equal to <color=#F74848>2.0</color>x Manipulator Repair AMT to all parts of a single ST. Can repair <color=#F74848>1</color> destroyed part.

500011.name: CEC 2
500011.SpecificEffects: <buf ID=900002>[Link Attack]</buf>'s effective times per turn <color=#F74848>+1</color>.

500012.name: Part Maintenance 1
500012.SpecificEffects: After performing active repairs, dispel <color=#F74848>1</color> debuff.

500021.name: CEC 3
500021.SpecificEffects: <buf ID=900002>[Link Attack]</buf>'s damage multiplier is increased to <color=#F74848>0.3</color>.

500031.name: Emergency Repair 1
500031.SpecificEffects: At the end of the action, randomly select a single adjacent (<color=#F74848>1</color> tile) ally to perform <buf ID=900018>[Passive Repair]</buf>. The repair amount is <color=#F74848>0.6x</color> the Manipulator's Repair AMT and cannot repair damaged parts.

500033.name: Flexible Repair
500033.SpecificEffects: After performing active repairs, an additional <color=#F74848>2</color> tiles can be moved.

500034.name: Emergency Repair 2
500034.SpecificEffects: <buf ID=900018>[Passive Repair]</buf> selects targets within the adjacent (<color=#F74848>2</color> tiles) area.

500035.name: Emergency Repair 3
500035.SpecificEffects: <buf ID=900018>[Passive Repair]</buf>'s Repair AMT is now <color=#F74848>1x</color> that of the Manipulator.

500036.name: Emergency Repair 4
500036.SpecificEffects: The number of targets that <buf ID=900018>[Passive Repair]</buf> can repair increases by <color=#F74848>1</color>.
